title: flaky_test_pattern_detector
goal: Detect flaky test patterns from execution history, calculate coverage deltas, and generate visual sequence trace diagrams.

milestones.name: flaky_log_analyzer
milestones.goal: Parse test execution logs to identify tests with inconsistent pass/fail outcomes and compute coverage deltas.
milestones.test:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from app.analyzer import analyze_flaky_runs

def test_analyze_flaky_runs():
    runs = [
        {'test_name': 'test_login', 'status': 'failed', 'code': 'def test_login(): pass'},
        {'test_name': 'test_login', 'status': 'passed', 'code': 'def test_login(): assert True'}
    ]
    res = analyze_flaky_runs(runs)
    assert 'test_login' in res['flaky_tests']
    assert res['flaky_tests']['test_login']['flakiness_rate'] == 0.5
    assert 'coverage_delta' in res

milestones.name: flaky_sequence_diagrammer
milestones.goal: Generate PlantUML sequence diagrams illustrating interaction sequences during test attempts and retries.
milestones.test:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from app.diagrammer import generate_sequence_diagram

def test_generate_sequence_diagram():
    events = [
        {'actor': 'Runner', 'target': 'API', 'message': 'GET /user (500)'},
        {'actor': 'Runner', 'target': 'API', 'message': 'GET /user (200)'}
    ]
    puml = generate_sequence_diagram(events, title='Retry Flow')
    assert '@startuml' in puml
    assert 'Retry Flow' in puml

milestones.name: flaky_report_generator
milestones.goal: Produce an integrated diagnostic markdown report containing flakiness metrics and embedded sequence diagrams.
